set.body: Build a small cross-compiled T1 registration engine around inverse-tracked midpoint maps, local factored/3x3 LM, physical smooth velocities, paired scaling-and-squaring, topology guards, and trust acceptance. Success requires JVM+JS contracts, independent deformation oracles, fair same-initialization ANTs comparisons, zero accepted folds on the validation policy, measured inverse error, and artifact-backed runtime/memory receipts. Supplied-affine nonlinear registration is the first release gate; FFT and learned proposals are optional extensions.
set.title: EPIC: HalfFlow-LM compact symmetric nonlinear registration
